title: Initiative pocket brief and escalation playbook for QBR readout
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Concise, one-page pocket brief for the upcoming QBR that summarizes initiative health across Runtime, Dedicated, and Private. Designed to fit on a single slide for the executive table (title, 3 signals, top 3 asks, escalation playbook). This ticket covers synthesis, stakeholder alignment, and prep for the readout rehearsal.
objective: Deliver a compact decision-ready packet for execs that highlights progress against OKRs, surface material risks, and requests 2 prioritized investment/operational decisions with clear success criteria.
agenda: 2) 3 signal highlights: metrics trend, cost/latency delta, customer impact
key_metrics: Runtime p50 latency (ms) - 95th percentile trending: 230ms -> 210ms last 30d
Cost per 1K tokens (USD) - effective unit: hosted vs dedicated: hosted $0.18, dedicated $0.09
Adoption: internal early access routes using new streaming API: 18 -> 36 routes (MoM +100%)
Quality guardrail: eval regressions triggered: 2 regressions in model-variant Canary
initiative_summaries: Serving Runtime: On track. Shipping kernel selection prototype in runtime-1.19; initial perf gains of 8-12% on chat workloads. Next: rollout to canary cluster 10/07.
Dedicated Capacity: Slightly behind. Autoscaling policy debug uncovered race in pool release path; mitigation: temporary conservative scaling config to avoid capacity dip. Targeted deploy 10/12.
Private/VPC: High confidence. Air-gapped installer v0.3 completed acceptance tests; remaining work: upgrade docs and KMS integration playbook due 10/04.
Console & Observability: Needs more polish. Token-level cost explorer prototype has stakeholder feedback loop—design changes requested to surface route-level anomalies before QBR rehearsal.
risks: Risk: Dedicated autoscaler race could cause transient 5-10m capacity gaps during high demand. Impact: medium-high for customers on reserved capacity. Mitigation: conservative autoscaling policy + on-call runbook; escalation if reoccurs after 10/12 deploy.
Risk: Kernel selection rollout may regress some long-context models. Impact: low-medium. Mitigation: rollback tag, targeted perf tests per model family, guardrail in rollout script.
Risk: Board ask for cost-savings target may require re-prioritizing Runtime perf work. Impact: strategic. Mitigation: present alternative cost scenarios with measurable delta at readout.
Risk: Incomplete customer-facing docs for Private installer could slow pilots. Mitigation: ship docs alpha and pairing sessions with pilot customers week of 10/06.
decisions_requested: Decision 1: Approve a temporary 15% spend reserve to buy headroom for Dedicated while autoscaler fix ships. Success criteria: no customer-impacting capacity shortages for next 30 days.

Decision 2: Prioritize kernel-selection rollout cadence: fast canary (2 clusters) vs conservative canary (1 cluster) — recommend conservative for controlled rollback. Success criteria: <1% model-level perf regressions and automated rollback tested.
Decision 3: Accept incremental deliverable to surface route-level cost alerts in Console MVP for Q4; tradeoff: delays other Console UI polish by one cycle.
